ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for §6 interpret and §7 OSINT (from console.anthropic.com). Without it, Layer-1 still works. (A secret named HHC_KEY is also accepted as an alias.)

HHC_KEY.description: Alias for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — use this OR ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, not both.

HHC_DB_KEY.description: Passphrase for the encrypted local case DB / accounts (SQLCipher). Optional normally; REQUIRED when HHC_AUTH=1 (accounts + sessions live here).

HHC_AUTH.description: Set to 1 to require login for the whole app (Admin/User accounts + MFA). Needs HHC_DB_KEY, HHC_SESSION_SECRET, HHC_ADMIN_EMAIL, HHC_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD.

HHC_SESSION_SECRET.description: Long random secret for session cookies + sealing the TOTP secret. Required when HHC_AUTH=1 (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 48`).

HHC_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first admin, created on first run when HHC_AUTH=1 and no users exist.

HHC_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Initial password for the first admin (must be changed + MFA enrolled at first login). Required when HHC_AUTH=1.

SMTP_HOST.description: Optional SMTP host for email MFA codes (with SMTP_PORT/SMTP_SECURE/SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS/SMTP_FROM). Unset → email MFA is a no-op; use TOTP.
